definitions.explanation: Something that is beyond doubt; guaranteed to happen.
Trustworthy and dependable; not likely to fail.

examples.japanese: {確実|かくじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me a method that will reliably deliver it.

{確実|かくじつ}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{確実|かくじつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

examples.english: With this weather, tomorrow's game will certainly take place.

notes:
{確実|かくじつ} means certain, reliable, or definite. It can function as both a na-adjective and a noun.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {確実|かくじつ}な (certain, reliable)
- Adverbial: {確実|かくじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (certainly, reliably)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {確実|かくじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ reliably/for certain)
- {確実|かくじつ}な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧ (reliable method)
- {確実|かくじつ}な⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧ (definite evidence)
- {確実|かくじつ}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (certainty, reliability)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧: 'probably,' 'if I remember correctly' - expresses uncertainty
- {確実|かくじつ}: 'certain,' 'definite' - expresses certainty
- ⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧: 'no doubt,' 'definitely'
